purpose: AI-prepared development diagnostics for local single-paper evidence QA v0.1; not product acceptance, learning acceptance, or a held-out benchmark.
artifact_availability: Raw run directories and AI review files are local ignored artifacts. Their complete contents are bound by the hashes below; this committed summary intentionally contains no paper quotations or private provider configuration.
provenance_scope: Code SHA, clean-tree status and file hashes identify the frozen diagnostic runner working tree. They are not an independent attestation of the running server build.

metric_rules.citation_count: Citation occurrences attached to delivered claims; the same source may occur in multiple claims.
metric_rules.programmatic_check: Citation presence, current-paper/page ownership and retrieved chunk identity; separate from semantic support.
metric_rules.semantic_review: Existing AI source reviews, separate from the application model verification. Full expected-point coverage is required for complete_supported_answer.
metric_rules.retrieval: Micro recall over each selected answerable question’s frozen expected_evidence anchors. Full runs cover 10 questions and 16 anchors; smoke runs cover only one question and one anchor. Five insufficient questions have no reference anchors and are excluded, not counted as recall 1.
metric_rules.latency: Per-question wall includes API submission/polling. Application processing and full-run wall are reported separately. P95 uses linear interpolation at rank (n-1)*0.95.
metric_rules.fees: Configured-price estimates are not invoices. Sol provider rates are unknown, so its estimated totals stay null. A known subtotal does not price unknown calls or mean free usage. Mini rates are never reused for Sol.
metric_rules.scope: Aggregate calls/tokens cover only these five runs, excluding browser tests and any other calls. This is not the global budget ledger or remaining allowance.

ai_review_limitations: Reviews are AI checks, not user acceptance.
The ReAct reviewer previously prepared AI gold, so its review is not blinded.
The same development questions informed improvements; results are not held-out performance.
ReAct-03 delivered claims are supported, but the answer omits the frozen-model and manually composed trajectory conditions.

remaining_omissions: Model is frozen in main prompting setup, not explicitly stated in delivered answer.
Few-shot trajectories are manually composed; stated in actual quote but omitted from delivered claim text.

listed_runs_totals.scope_note: Only the five named diagnostic runs; excludes browser and other model calls, and is not the global ledger or remaining allowance.
